ns2:section.sectionText: Section Info: This is a graduate-level course on network security. Students will gain a broad understanding of modern approaches to secure computer networks, across a variety of environments (ISPs, enterprises, cloud networks, and wireless systems), and from the physical to the application layer. Students will conduct an in-depth research project on a topic in the field of network security. This course complements other security offerings at UIUC such as CS 563, 461, and 463 to cover commonly used techniques to secure networks, and the advanced networking concepts behind them.
